description: Table 2: the partition (keyed hash or learned bands) crossed with the beliefs behind foresight, under the same objective. Reuses runs/ours_d3_d4, runs/dlm_kgw_d0 and calib/bands.json of Table 1 when they exist.

steps.name: ppl
steps.cmd: {PY_EVAL} scripts/score_ppl.py --runs runs/current_* runs/predictor_d2 runs/ours_d3_d4 runs/no_foresight_* runs/exact_* runs/hash_* --prompts data/waterbench600_llada.jsonl

steps.name: judge
steps.cmd: {PY_EVAL} scripts/judge.py --runs runs/current_* runs/predictor_d2 runs/ours_d3_d4 runs/no_foresight_* runs/exact_* runs/hash_* --prompts data/waterbench600_llada.jsonl --out judge/crossed

steps.name: report
steps.cmd: {PY} scripts/report.py --runs runs/current_* runs/predictor_d2 runs/ours_d3_d4 runs/no_foresight_* runs/exact_* runs/hash_* --thresholds calib/bands.json --thresholds hash_=calib/hash.json --judge judge/crossed/quality.json --contrast ours_d3:current_d3 --contrast current_d3:hash_current_d3 --interaction ours_d3:current_d3:hash_ours_d3:hash_current_d3 --out reports/crossed.json
